name: testimonials-wall
description: Masonry-style wall of testimonials showing all quotes at once for maximum social proof impact

ai.whenToUse: Use when you want all testimonials visible at once in a masonry grid. Great for dedicated testimonial pages, or sections where quantity of social proof matters. Works best with 6+ testimonials of varying length.
ai.whenNotToUse: Don't use with fewer than 4 testimonials. Avoid when you need one prominent testimonial — use testimonials-carousel instead.
